title: JuiceBox Session Charge Power Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=juicebox:session power_kw=*
| stats sum(power_kw) as total_value, avg(power_kw) as avg_value by location
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks location values by total and average charge power across JuiceBox session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_kw` values for each JuiceBox session event and review total and average charge power by location.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total charge power.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly which location shows the biggest charge power numbers in your JuiceBox session data.
